mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dispute_agent_run WHERE dispute_id=#{disputeId} AND submitted_evidence_version=#{evidenceVersion} AND status='SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM dispute_agent_run WHERE dispute_id=#{disputeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dispute_agent_run SET status='RUNNING',attempt=attempt+1,started_at=COALESCE(started_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE dispute_agent_run SET status='SUCCEEDED',result_json=#{resultJson},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE dispute_agent_run SET status=#{status},error_code=#{errorCode},error_message=#{errorMessage},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status IN ('RUNNING','PENDING')
UPDATE dispute_agent_run SET status='STALE',error_code=#{errorCode},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE dispute_agent_run SET adopted_by=#{adminId},adopted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,adopted_action=#{action} WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='SUCCEEDED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dispute_agent_run WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING') AND updated_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY updated_at,id LIMIT #{limit}
